metadata.description: Fails the run naming every Rust source file under engine/crates/*/src over 400 production lines, the limit in code-standards.md. Top-level #[cfg(test)] modules do not count, and neither do tests.rs files or tests/ folders. Run it from the repo root.

parameters.script:
# rust-file-size: fail naming every Rust source file over 400 production
# lines (code-standards.md). Every line counts except top-level
# `#[cfg(test)] mod <name> { ... }` blocks, wherever they sit in the file.
# Each argument is one file, relative to engine/crates.
# Gap: line counting in file-inspect will replace this step (dogfooding.md, PR 8).
limit=400
over=""
for file in "$@"; do
  lines=$(awk '
    skip { if ($0 == "}") skip = 0; next }
    pending { pending = 0; if ($0 ~ /^mod [A-Za-z0-9_]+ \{$/) { skip = 1; next } n++ }
    /^#\[cfg\(test\)\]$/ { pending = 1; next }
    { n++ }
    END { if (pending) n++; print n + 0 }
  ' "engine/crates/$file") || exit 2
  if [ "$lines" -gt "$limit" ]; then
    over="$over
  engine/crates/$file: $lines"
  fi
done

if [ -n "$over" ]; then
  echo "Over $limit production lines (split the file; see code-standards.md):$over" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Every Rust source file is within $limit production lines."
